execution: Each scenario and version ran three serial rounds, with baseline and optimized scenarios run sequentially; no controlled cold cache. Each run independent Docker volume, 2 CPUs, 256 MiB, no swap.
limitations: Time includes driver and per-request overhead; write timing includes SQL generation. Raw io.stat read after sync before shutdown; not verified device attribution or full writeback, so cannot calculate official E. Fixed seed and uniform tag distribution; no hidden seeds.
